name: Ember Trial 1
text: Puddlet against Smoldrake in the ash storm. Win within 4 turns.
hint_1: Smoldrake fights Ember with Ember. Your Tide arts hit it hard, but Energy is short in the storm.
hint_2: Open with Fizz Pop, call the tide once, then keep up the Fizz Pop.

name: Ember Trial 2
text: Kindlop burns, and its Kindling gift turns the Scorch into strength. It starts with 5 Energy. Beat Shalebat and Zippit without curing the Scorch.
hint_1: Kindlop only has 5 Energy. Plan one rest, and spend the rest of it on blows that count.
hint_2: Glow Knuckle twice, rest once, then Glow Knuckle and Cinder Nip.

name: Ember Trial 3
text: Mossling at half Vigor against Kindlop. Win within 5 turns.
hint_1: Kindlop wants to heat up. Hit it before it gets going, and do not wait.
hint_2: Pollen Prick twice, a puff of Puffcap Haze, then finish with Pollen Prick.

name: Current Trial 1
text: Zippit starts with 4 Energy against a soaked Riptail. Win within 3 turns through the Volt reaction.
hint_1: The Volt reaction needs a soaked foe and a Volt art. Riptail is already soaked.
hint_2: Bite twice with Crackle Bite, then end it with Static Tag.

name: Current Trial 2
text: Zephlet starts with 2 Energy against Puddlet in the high tide. Win, resting exactly once.
hint_1: With 2 Energy, Zephlet cannot strike well yet. The one rest belongs at the start.
hint_2: Rest first, then Crosswind twice and Draft Needle to finish.

name: Current Trial 3
text: Riptail and Kestra's Zephlet against Zippit and Kelpup. Win without losing a Spirling.
hint_1: Kestra's Zephlet plays on its own. Keep Zippit from getting a second turn.
hint_2: Pull Zippit under with Undertow, then Rip Current, then Rip Current again.
